Small-batch coffee, roasted every week

Our beans

Fernhill Coffee roasts small batches of single-origin beans every week, from farms we visit ourselves. Every bag ships within two days of roasting, so it reaches you at its best. Our café in the hills is open every day from eight until five.

Brewing guides

Start with our filter guide, then try espresso and cold brew. Each guide lists the grind, the ratio and the time, with tips for getting the most out of light roasts.
